desc: Initial greedy attempt (place v=1..N with rank) - gives wrong answer on sample 1

Implement correct solution: ans = sum_{v=1}^{N} v * #{u < v : pos[u] > pos[v]}. Use a BIT: for each v from 1 to N, query(pos[v]-1) gives #{u < v : pos[u] <= pos[v]}, so #{u < v : pos[u] > pos[v]} = (v-1) - query(pos[v]-1). Contribution = v * ((v-1) - query(pos[v]-1)). Then update BIT at pos[v] with +1.
Verify the solution on all three sample inputs (expect: 4, 6, 0)
Handle edge cases and ensure O(N log N) time complexity for N up to 2*10^5
